title: Answers go straight to the agent

options.label: Straight to the agent through Switchboard, copy as a fallback
options.act: Socket ops board_answers/board_wait + CLI; Sent state + per-card acknowledgement
options.then: Send answers through Switchboard (socket and CLI) with a Sent state and per-card acknowledgement; copy stays as the fallback.

why: No more copy-paste. "Send" hands the answers to Switchboard, and the agent reads them with switchboard review answers, or waits for them with --wait the way switchboard wait already waits for a server. The page shows "Sent 10:42", and the agent acknowledges each card as it picks it up (Linear asks agents to acknowledge within 10 seconds). Copy-to-chat stays as the fallback. Flex's prototype already works this way: when Flex serves the board, Send goes straight to the agent ("Served by Flex"), and Show as text is the fallback. Switchboard plays Flex's part.
